Alexander German, son of Fani and Itzhak, was born in 1956 in Argentina.

Alexander (Alex) grew up in Argentina, and when he was fourteen he immigrated with his family to Israel. The family settled in Rehovot.

In high school he studied to be a cook.

Upon finishing high school, Alexander enlisted in the IDF and served in the Navy, in the submarine unit. At the end of his compulsory service he continued to serve in the regular army.

In 1986 he married Esther. They built their home in Haifa, and there they raised their three children. Alexander was a devoted and loving family man, and his children respected and loved him very much. When the children grew up, the family moved to Ramla.

Alexander loved to paint and to read, and he spoke several languages.

Alexander German passed away on 8 Elul 5766 (1 September 2006). He was fifty years old at his passing. He was laid to rest in the cemetery in Ramla. He left behind a wife, three children, his parents, and a brother.

On his headstone, his loved ones wrote: "Your memory is forever in our hearts."
